title: Lesson 26: Enterprise Deployment, Serving, API Design, Rate Limits, and Quotas
description: A working agent is a different thing from an agent many people can use. This lesson puts the three boundaries around it that make the difference: the serving layer that decides how much concurrent work the model can do, the API boundary that gives every consumer one stable interface, and the policy layer of rate limits and quotas that stops a single tenant from overwhelming the hardware or blowing the budget. It works through the numbers you need to size a deployment, and it shows how those three layers meet at the same number.
